<evidence source_path="requirements/REQ-QA-02.md" doc_type="requirement" requirement_id="REQ-QA-02">
Retry helper must retry a failing operation up to 3 times before raising the last error.
</evidence>
<evidence source_path="utils/retry.py" doc_type="code">
def retry(operation, attempts=3):
    last_error = None
    for _ in range(attempts):
        try:
            return operation()
        except Exception as exc:
            last_error = exc
    raise last_error

</evidence>
